entry.title: New: dsh-hindsight-local-optimize
entry.summary: Local-memory lifecycle for the official Hindsight plugin on DSH desktop: one-click start/stop of the hindsight-embed daemon, auto-start on boot, stop on exit, hides the uv.exe console window, and installs the vault/models to another drive. Exact install spec: github:hua1q1ng/dsh-hindsight-local-optimize. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
